# ISO/IEC 29500 Strict OOXML fixtures

`sample_strict.docx`, `sample_strict.xlsx`, and `sample_strict.pptx` are
Strict-namespace variants of the small synthetic packages in
`samples/source/sample.docx`, `sample.xlsx`, and `sample.pptx`. They are
generated by `scripts/generate-strict-ooxml-fixtures.py`, which maps the Office Open XML
Transitional namespaces and relationship type URIs to the ISO Strict PURL
namespaces. Package paths and content types remain unchanged.

The fixtures contain synthetic sample content and no user documents or
personal data. The conversion tests verify that the Word, SpreadsheetML, and
PresentationML parsers follow Strict namespaces and relationship targets.
